name: slopegraph
title: Slopegraph
description: One line per record between left and right values on a shared vertical scale to highlight discrepancies.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Each {unitOne} is a line from {leftShort} on the left to {rightShort} on the right. A level line agrees. A line that tilts differs, in the colour of the side that is higher.

options.name: scale
options.description: Scale transformation for the vertical axis: square root to compress high values, or linear.

options.name: labelOnly
options.description: Which lines to label on the chart: exceptions only, or all records.
